teaching_goals: translate natural-language success conditions into one normal requires clause
express both observable directions of a bidirectional relation
encode exception priority with mutually exclusive signals conditions
recognize that exceptional behavior is atomic

criteria.expectation: The normal condition requires both users, distinct IDs, and an absent id1-to-id2 following relation.
The first success postcondition establishes getUser(id1).isFollowing(getUser(id2)).
The four signals conditions are disjoint and preserve the stated validation priority.
The submission uses only symbols available in the official interface and the supplied template.

hint_policy.hint: Identify categories and direct the next reasoning step; do not quote a complete replacement clause.
hint_policy.review: Identify exact missing semantics and explain why, but do not output the completed specification.
hint_policy.solution: May provide corrected clauses and a complete reference answer.
